question: Where should you position your car before turning left into a side road?
options: Well over to the left kerb
explain: Rule 182: To keep well to the left before turning left.

question: When should you switch on your left indicator before turning left?
options: In good time before slowing and turning
Only if a car is behind
explain: Rule 182 and Rule 103 say to give a clear left signal in good time.

question: Why should you not swing out to the right before turning left?
options: Rule 182 warns it misleads following drivers and risks a crash
explain: Rule 182 says not to swing out to the right before a left turn.

question: Before moving close to the left kerb for a left turn, what should you check?
options: Your nearside mirror and blind spot for cyclists
explain: Rule 182 warns to watch out for cyclists coming up on your left.

question: If you pass a side road you did not want, what should you do?
options: Drive on and find a safe place to turn
Reverse back up the main road
Stop in the middle of the lane
explain: Rule 182: Never make a late swerve; carry on safely and turn later.

question: What should you do if a cyclist is riding on your left just. Before your left turn?
options: Hold back behind them until they pass the junction
explain: Rule 182 and Rule H3 require you to. Give way and never cut across a cyclist.

question: Should you slow down before you start steering into a tight left turn?
options: Yes, brake in a straight line before turning
explain: Rule 182 advises adjusting your speed smoothly before reaching the corner.

question: When turning left into a side road. Who has priority if someone is waiting to cross it?
explain: Rule 182 and Rule H2 say to give. Way to pedestrians crossing or waiting to cross.
